title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #17

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah has only three verses? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Masad
   D. An-Nasr

2. What is the best way to avoid wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to eat
   B. Feed it to no one
   C. Take a very large plate
   D. Take only what you can finish

3. Who was the boy taught the manners of eating in the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ali as an old man
   B. Abu Jahl
   C. Bilal
   D. Umar ibn Abi Salamah

4. What happens when germs feed on sugar left on teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing happens
   B. They make acid that causes cavities
   C. Teeth become stronger
   D. Teeth grow longer

5. Who recorded the syllabus hadith about brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Lahab
   B. Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   C. Khadija
   D. Waraqa

6. Which of these is a benefit of clean teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Fresh breath
   B. More cavities
   C. Toothache
   D. Bad breath

7. Which greeting should players give at the end of a match? (1 mark)
   A. A shout
   B. Salaam and a handshake
   C. An insult
   D. Silence

8. Kevin returns a lost charger when nobody sees him. Which belief helped him? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is a picture
   B. Nobody cares
   C. Allah is far away
   D. Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing

9. Which name teaches that Allah owns everything we have? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. As-Sami'

10. What does "Al-Malik" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Source of Peace
   B. The King and Owner of everything
   C. The All-Seeing
   D. The Most Kind

11. Which angels do Muslims believe sit beside every person? (1 mark)
   A. None
   B. Ten guards
   C. Two recording angels
   D. Four rain angels

12. Which pillar of Iman are we practising when we say "I believe in the angels"? (1 mark)
   A. Belief in the Last Day
   B. Belief in the books
   C. Belief in Allah's angels
   D. Belief in destiny

13. What should we remember when we think of Israfil? (1 mark)
   A. Rain will stop
   B. We must fear dogs
   C. Prayer is not needed
   D. The Day of Judgement is true

14. Why do Muslims believe in all the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. They are all angels
   B. They all lived in Makkah
   C. They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   D. They were all kings

15. How is a heavy najasa such as dog saliva cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Wash seven times, once with soil
   B. Wipe with dry cloth
   C. Do nothing
   D. Sprinkle water once

16. What is a mughalladha najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A light najasa
   C. A heavy najasa
   D. A medium najasa

17. Which is a health reason for washing away najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. It stops rain
   B. It makes food taste sweet
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It prevents diseases like diarrhoea

18. How many times do we usually wash each part in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Once only for all
   C. Twenty
   D. Ten

19. What is the meaning of niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer mat
   B. Prayer times
   C. Direction
   D. Intention in the heart

20. Which part is washed first in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Feet
   C. Hands
   D. Ears

21. What do we say in ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   B. Alhamdulillah
   C. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   D. Bismillah

22. What should we say when dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Amin
   C. Bismillah
   D. Nothing

23. Which of these is a manner of dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ask with humility and hope
   B. Demand
   C. Give up quickly
   D. Shout

24. What did the Prophet say about dua? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for old people
   B. It is a game
   C. It is not needed
   D. It is worship

25. When should you say the dua for leaving? (1 mark)
   A. After meals
   B. As you step out of the door
   C. When going to bed
   D. At night only

26. Which family event should we attend to keep ties? (1 mark)
   A. Only cartoons
   B. Nothing
   C. Only sad events
   D. A wedding or naming ceremony

27. Who is a "babu"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandmother
   B. Cousin
   C. Grandfather
   D. Aunt

28. What is the Night of the first revelation often connected with? (1 mark)
   A. Hajj
   B. Mawlid
   C. Laylat al-Qadr
   D. Eid

29. What did Khadija notice about Muhammad? (1 mark)
   A. His speed
   B. His wealth
   C. His height
   D. His honesty and trustworthiness

30. What should you do if you fail a test? (1 mark)
   A. Study more and try again
   B. Cheat
   C. Blame others
   D. Give up

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

32. Plan a Muslim school sports day including at least five rules or activities. (5 marks)

33. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

34. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)

35. Explain the meaning of "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both." (3 marks)

36. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

37. What can children do for parents who have passed away? (3 marks)

38. Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each. (5 marks)

39. Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah. (3 marks)

40. State two ways a child can earn or save money safely. (2 marks)

41. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)

42. Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching. (2 marks)

43. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

44. Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul. (2 marks)

45. Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik. (3 marks)

46. Explain what a person should do if they do not like a food served to them. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

2. D — Take only what you can finish
   Small portions can be repeated if needed.

3. D — Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   He lived in the Prophet's home.

4. B — They make acid that causes cavities
   Acid damages the teeth.

5. B — Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   The syllabus names Ibn Majah.

6. A — Fresh breath
   Clean teeth give fresh breath.

7. B — Salaam and a handshake
   Respect and greetings are Islamic manners.

8. D — Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   He knows Allah sees everything.

9. A — Al-Malik
   Everything belongs to the true King.

10. B — The King and Owner of everything
   Al-Malik means the true King.

11. C — Two recording angels
   The Qur'an (50:17-18) mentions two.

12. C — Belief in Allah's angels
   It is the second pillar of Iman.

13. D — The Day of Judgement is true
   The Trumpet will be blown by Allah's command.

14. C — They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   Islam makes no difference in belief.

15. A — Wash seven times, once with soil
   This is the method for heavy najasa.

16. C — A heavy najasa
   Mughalladha means heavy.

17. D — It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   Cleanliness prevents germs.

18. A — Three
   The Sunnah is three times.

19. D — Intention in the heart
   Niyyah is intention.

20. C — Hands
   The hands are washed first.

21. A — Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   Glory to my Lord, the Most Great.

22. C — Bismillah
   Say Bismillah for good acts.

23. A — Ask with humility and hope
   Dua is humble.

24. D — It is worship
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

25. B — As you step out of the door
   At the time of leaving.

26. D — A wedding or naming ceremony
   Attending strengthens ties.

27. C — Grandfather
   Babu means grandfather.

28. C — Laylat al-Qadr
   Surah 97 speaks about it.

29. D — His honesty and trustworthiness
   That is why she respected him.

30. A — Study more and try again
   Perseverance.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: Bismillah at the start, modest kits, fair play, warm-up, stop for prayer, respect referees, greet teams, thank Allah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule or activity, up to 5.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both types have good because of faith. But a strong believer can do more good, so a Muslim should try to be strong in body and faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for good in both, 1 mark for strong can do more good, 1 mark for the lesson.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave it quietly and politely without criticising, as the Prophet did, and thank the person.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not criticising, 1 mark for quietness or politeness, 1 mark for thanks.
